The registry is one source of names; preludes are another (scanf, var_export, pdo all moved into
PHP preludes), so a name absent from the registry is not necessarily absent from the compiler.
The honest question is whether the CHECKER resolves the name, and it answers many at once: it
recovers from errors, so one file naming every candidate yields one `Undefined function:` line
per genuinely missing name.

Calling each with no arguments is deliberate — a function that EXISTS answers with an arity or
